account: original configured session; identity not observed

findings.fix: Reject covered namespace names with missing __file__ unless explicitly allowlisted, and document/reduce TOCTOU by re-verifying immediately before mutations or adding an import hook; keep the not-cryptographic-attestation caveat in the registration contract.
findings.issue: verify_runtime_sources skips covered-namespace modules where __file__ is None, so a file-less sys.modules entry for specorganon/scripts/experiments bypasses path/bytes binding. It also only checks already-imported modules, so lazy imports after verification are unchecked until the next validate(). Guard is therefore source-path pinning, not in-memory bytecode attestation.

findings.fix: Validate phase membership and raise ControllerError on unknown phase.
findings.issue: phase_guidance(task['phase']) indexes PHASE_GUIDANCE directly. An unknown phase raises raw KeyError, not ControllerError, escaping the controller error contract and the run() catch list that handles ControllerError/ValueError/OSError.

findings.fix: Validate state shape and raise ValueError/ControllerError fail-closed.
findings.issue: reference_maintenance assumes state['items'][id]['deps/version/stale/issues'] shape and raises raw KeyError/TypeError on malformed state. Called inside _request, this escapes as non-ControllerError/non-ValueError.

findings.fix: Enforce the ceiling on the actual transmitted canonical bytes, or prove _encoded length upper-bounds canonical length.
findings.issue: Hint ceiling is measured with _encoded, but software_controller transmits canonical(reference_maintenance(state)). If canonical encoding differs, transmitted reference-maintenance.json can exceed max_reference_hint_bytes even when _encoded passes.

findings.fix: Bind a digest of the hint/guidance logic or require a schema bump on any hint-logic change.
findings.issue: Policy migration binds artifact_data_contract_sha256 but only a static reference_hint_schema value. Changes to reference-maintenance/hint logic without a manual schema bump do not force a versioned run.

findings.fix: Remove the dead constant or assert consistency with the served per-phase guidance.
findings.issue: ARTIFACT_GUIDANCE constant is now dead after _request switched to phase_guidance(task['phase']); retaining it risks divergence between reviewed guidance text and served guidance.
